name: In:Evanescence
source:
Who are you?

Where are you?

Why are you here?

All these things escape you.

There's two... people? who are helping you navigate... someone's consciousness?

It doesn't help that you keep forgetting.

Objectives: survive, romance the possibly-people while you're at it, promptly forget how you managed to do that .

[From [url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/inevanescence]itch.io[/url]]
